the-dungeon-of-black-company.desc: Kinji Ninomiya is a young man overflowing with extreme overconfidence. Right when he thought he was set to live a cushy NEET lifestyle, he was swept off to another world.

the-dungeon-of-black-company.name: Wanibe
the-dungeon-of-black-company.desc: Wanibe is a reptilian who took up Kinji on one of his get-rich-quick schemes. Now he's thoroughly wrapped up in Kinji's shenanigans. A helpless guy who mostly ends up getting used as an underling, which suits him just fine.

the-dungeon-of-black-company.name: Rim
the-dungeon-of-black-company.desc: Rim is a ferocious dragon that often takes the appearance of a little girl. In the exchange for a promise for tasty food, she helps [Kinji](https://anilist.co/character/179362/Kinji-Ninomiya) out. She has a voracious appetite.

the-dungeon-of-black-company.name: Ranga
the-dungeon-of-black-company.desc: Ranga is an effeminite male mage. He followed Kinji Ninomiya from a messed up future in order to knock some sense into his ancestor from current times.

the-dungeon-of-black-company.name: Shia Kinou
the-dungeon-of-black-company.desc: Shia Kinou is one of the main protagonists in Meikyuu Black Company. She is a hero who is known for possessing The Philosopher's Stone by conquering The Fifth Floor of the dungeon.

battle-game-in-5-seconds.name: Akira  Shiroyanagi
battle-game-in-5-seconds.desc: Ability: Possesses whichever ability the other person thinks he has. Akira Shiroyanagi is a high schooler who loves games and Konpeito. He is bored with his everyday life and hence tries out many games hoping to find something to…

battle-game-in-5-seconds.name: Yuuri Amagake
battle-game-in-5-seconds.desc: Ability: Quintuple her physical abilities She is a second year high school student.

battle-game-in-5-seconds.name: Satoru Saruwatari
battle-game-in-5-seconds.desc: Ability: To turn buttons into ropes.

battle-game-in-5-seconds.name: Asuka Kiryuu
battle-game-in-5-seconds.desc: Ability: To transform sticks into blades of any weight. Member of Team Green

battle-game-in-5-seconds.name: Takakiyo Chaen
battle-game-in-5-seconds.desc: Ability: To tranform a toy into a real thing.

battle-game-in-5-seconds.name: Ichi Oogami
battle-game-in-5-seconds.desc: Ability: The ability to quintuple your physical abilities. The leader of the Red Team.

battle-game-in-5-seconds.name: Shin Kumagiri
battle-game-in-5-seconds.desc: Ability: To become invincible for 2 seconds. Kumagiri Shin is a pro wrestler.

battle-game-in-5-seconds.name: Naoharu Kamui
battle-game-in-5-seconds.desc: Ability: To cause chemical changes in things around your hand. Member of the Red Team.

battle-game-in-5-seconds.name: Renka
battle-game-in-5-seconds.desc: Ability: The ability to control any toy you create. ~!It was thought that Renka's ability was to control any toy she created but it turns out that she is a mere puppet. She is the result of Souta Tsuchida, who has the real ability to…

the-executioner-and-her-way-of-life.name: Akari Tokitou
the-executioner-and-her-way-of-life.desc: The Lost One. She is affectionate and easy-going. Menou is unable to kill her because of her ability even though she is not aware of it herself. She begins her journey with Menou, without knowing her true intentions.

the-executioner-and-her-way-of-life.name: Menou
the-executioner-and-her-way-of-life.desc: The Executioner. A young executioner girl who has exceptional magical talent. She is strongly dedicated to her mission and tries to finish off [Akari](https://anilist.co/character/161696) before her power gets out of hand. She gets…

the-executioner-and-her-way-of-life.name: Momo
the-executioner-and-her-way-of-life.desc: Apprentice priestess working under [Menou](https://anilist.co/character/161698/Menou). She is deeply attached to Menou but has near zero religious faith. She is good at fighting with a fretsaw, but has poor skill with scripture magic.

the-executioner-and-her-way-of-life.name: Sicilia
the-executioner-and-her-way-of-life.desc: Priest of the port city Libelle. She works under Flare and they seem to be acquainted but further details are unclear.

the-executioner-and-her-way-of-life.name: Ashuna Grizarica
the-executioner-and-her-way-of-life.desc: Traveling Princess Knight. Princess of the Grizarica Kingdom, who is strong and beautiful. People call her the "Princess Knight" and she carries a sword with the royal crest as she always is ready for a fight.

the-executioner-and-her-way-of-life.name: Shoujo
the-executioner-and-her-way-of-life.desc: ~!One of the four Human Errors, demon of the fog Pandemonium which was sealed away. She takes the form of a young girl, but her true body is still inside the fog. She has lost the memories and personality from before she became a Human…

the-executioner-and-her-way-of-life.name: Mitsuki
the-executioner-and-her-way-of-life.desc: He was summoned from another world with the ability "nothingness" and was immediately thrown out of the castle. He wandered around aimlessly until he met [Menou](https://anilist.co/character/161698/Menou)

the-executioner-and-her-way-of-life.name: Flare
the-executioner-and-her-way-of-life.desc: Skilled priest and executioner, who has killed the most Lost Ones from other worlds. She is [Menou](https://anilist.co/character/161698/Menou)'s mentor and Menou is considered her successor.

the-executioner-and-her-way-of-life.name: Orwell
the-executioner-and-her-way-of-life.desc: The Archbishop. She is trusted by many people and has the greatest skill in magic of her era. She offers [Menou](https://anilist.co/character/161698/Menou) help in killing [Akari](https://anilist.co/character/161696/Akari-Tokitou)…

the-executioner-and-her-way-of-life.name: Manon Libelle
the-executioner-and-her-way-of-life.desc: Representative of the Libelle Family Head. Sole daughter of Count Libelle, who acts as the representative of the family after the Count fell ill. She is always dressed in a kimono and carries herself gracefully.

akebi-s-sailor-uniform.name: Komichi Akebi
akebi-s-sailor-uniform.desc: Class 1-3, student number 1. A girl who has a strong yearning for sailor uniforms due to a certain reason. She has a bright and straightforward personality, and is really looking forward to school life. She is very good at sports.…

akebi-s-sailor-uniform.name: Ayumi Togeguchi
akebi-s-sailor-uniform.desc: Class 1-3, student number 10. She is careful not to speak in a dialect. Because of this, she doesn't talk much in class. However, when she gets emotional, she sometimes can't stop herself. (Source: Official Site, Translated)

akebi-s-sailor-uniform.name: Miki Fukumoto
akebi-s-sailor-uniform.desc: An idol that Komichi admires. (Source: Official Site)

akebi-s-sailor-uniform.name: Erika Kizaki
akebi-s-sailor-uniform.desc: Class 1-3, student number 5. The first classmate that [Komichi](https://anilist.co/character/159265/Akebi-Komichi) met. She has the air of a young lady, but also has an active side that likes fishing and mountain climbing.

akebi-s-sailor-uniform.name: Ai Tatsumori
akebi-s-sailor-uniform.desc: Class 1-3, student number 8. A girl who aims to be the best at everything. She is the head of the school. She hates to lose and has a strong desire to improve. (Source: Official Site, Translated)

akebi-s-sailor-uniform.name: Yuwa Akebi
akebi-s-sailor-uniform.desc: Komichi's mother. She works as a seamstress at home, and made Komichi's sailor suit. She is a graduate of Robai Private Academy. (Source: Official Site, Translated)

akebi-s-sailor-uniform.name: Touko Usagihara
akebi-s-sailor-uniform.desc: Class 1-3, student number 2. She has good communication skills and a cheerful personality. She knows a lot of rumors about her classmates. (Source: Official Site, Translated)

akebi-s-sailor-uniform.name: Neko Kamimoku
akebi-s-sailor-uniform.desc: Class 1-3, student number 4. She always looks sleepy and often dozes off in class, which the teacher often cautions her about. (Source: Official Site, Translated)

akebi-s-sailor-uniform.name: Kao Akebi
akebi-s-sailor-uniform.desc: Komichi's younger sister. A third-grader. She looks just like Komichi, but has a strong personality. She sometimes encourages her sister.

mobile-suit-gundam-the-witch-from-mercur.name: Suletta Mercury
mobile-suit-gundam-the-witch-from-mercur.desc: A second-year student in the piloting department, who transferred to the school from Mercury. Suletta is timid and somewhat lacks communication skills. She is the pilot of the Gundam Aerial developed on Mercury. ~!Suletta was one of the…

mobile-suit-gundam-the-witch-from-mercur.name: Miorine Rembran
mobile-suit-gundam-the-witch-from-mercur.desc: An attractive and academically distinguished second-year student in the management strategy department. Miorine is the only daughter of Delling Rembran, the president of the Beneritt Group and chairman of the school's board. She has a…

mobile-suit-gundam-the-witch-from-mercur.name: Elan Ceres
mobile-suit-gundam-the-witch-from-mercur.desc: The top pilot backed by Peil Technologies, one of the group's three branches. A third-year student in the piloting department. Elan is a taciturn and solitary person, who doesn't open his heart to anyone in school. He has an interest to…

mobile-suit-gundam-the-witch-from-mercur.name: Vim Jeturk
mobile-suit-gundam-the-witch-from-mercur.desc: Guel's father, and CEO of the Jeturk company, one of the Benerit Group's three branches.

mobile-suit-gundam-the-witch-from-mercur.name: Felsi Rollo
mobile-suit-gundam-the-witch-from-mercur.desc: She is a second-year pilot in the Jeturk House. The type of person who is a reckless, headstrong pilot. She respects Guel as a pilot.

mobile-suit-gundam-the-witch-from-mercur.desc: He is the head of the Earth Dormitory and a third-year student in the Department of Business Strategy. He is an indecisive and somewhat unreliable leader. He has a hard time dealing with the dorm members who have strong personalities.

mobile-suit-gundam-the-witch-from-mercur.name: Belmeria Winston
mobile-suit-gundam-the-witch-from-mercur.desc: As a researcher at Peil Technologies, she is involved with the development of the Gundam Pharact. ~!She is one of the surviving staff members of the Vanadis Institute.!~

mobile-suit-gundam-the-witch-from-mercur.name: Guel Jeturk
mobile-suit-gundam-the-witch-from-mercur.desc: An heir to Jeturk Heavy Machinery, one of the group's three branches, and a third-year student in the piloting department. Guel has a rough temperament and is quick to anger. As the ace pilot of Jeturk House, he has absolute confidence…

mobile-suit-gundam-the-witch-from-mercur.desc: A first-year mechanic in the Burion House. He belongs to the Dueling Committee. He is familiar with mobile crafts and other mecha, and always carries his own modified Haro.

mobile-suit-gundam-the-witch-from-mercur.name: Petra Itta
mobile-suit-gundam-the-witch-from-mercur.desc: She is a second-year mechanic student in the Jeturk House. She is the cool, intelligent, honor student type. Much like Felsi, she adores Guel.

mobile-suit-gundam-the-witch-from-mercur.name: Nuno Kargan
mobile-suit-gundam-the-witch-from-mercur.desc: He is a second-year mechanic in the Earth dormitory. He is a geek who is well versed in software, and he and Ojero work together as partners in crime.

mobile-suit-gundam-the-witch-from-mercur.name: Guston Parche
mobile-suit-gundam-the-witch-from-mercur.desc: A spaceship pilot who works with the smuggler Feng Jun. ~!Both he and Feng Jun secretly work for the Space Assembly League, with the smuggling business being a front.!~

urusei-yatsura-2022-seasons-1-2.name: Lum
urusei-yatsura-2022-seasons-1-2.desc: Lum is a beautiful Oni alien who is capable of flying and generating electrical shocks. She is extremely popular and is famous for ending her sentences with ~datcha (loosely translated as "yes?" or "you know?"). Except when in her…

urusei-yatsura-2022-seasons-1-2.name: Ataru Moroboshi
urusei-yatsura-2022-seasons-1-2.desc: A student at Tomobiki High School, Class 2-4, Ataru suffers from an incredible amount of bad luck, having been born on the unluckiest day of the Bhuddist calendar. He is very lecherous, stupid, and lazy. Though he often tries to escape…

urusei-yatsura-2022-seasons-1-2.name: Oyuki
urusei-yatsura-2022-seasons-1-2.desc: Oyuki is the queen of Neptune, which in the series is a frozen, snowy planet populated entirely by women, as most of the men have to go off-planet to find work. As a child she used to hang out with Lum, Ran, and Benten when they were…

urusei-yatsura-2022-seasons-1-2.name: Benten
urusei-yatsura-2022-seasons-1-2.desc: Lum's childhood friend and most loyal friend in the Galaxy. Her character is named after Shichifukujin Benzaiten (one of the Seven Lucky Gods), the Shinto goddess of knowledge, art, and beauty. This Benten is a "space biker chick" who…

onimai-i-m-now-your-sister.desc: [Mahiro](https://anilist.co/character/130822/Oyama-Mahiro)'s little sister. A genius scientist that skipped grades and is now attending college. She is responsible for drugging Mahiro, turning him into a young girl.

onimai-i-m-now-your-sister.name: Mahiro Oyama
onimai-i-m-now-your-sister.desc: He was a hikikomori neet and loner, until he woke up one morning as a little girl thanks to his [younger sister](https://anilist.co/character/130823/Oyama-Mihari) drugging him.

onimai-i-m-now-your-sister.name: Momiji Hozuki

onimai-i-m-now-your-sister.name: Kaede Hozuki
onimai-i-m-now-your-sister.desc: Kaede is a close personal friend of [Mihari](https://anilist.co/character/130823/Oyama-Mihari). They became friends in middle school. Mihari has progressed further in the academic system than Kaede, but they still are close, and see…

onimai-i-m-now-your-sister.desc: Nemu is frequently seen sleeping. She sleeps throughout the entire day, even sleeping in gym class and while standing up.

onimai-i-m-now-your-sister.desc: Asahi is a classmate of [Mahiro](https://anilist.co/character/130822/Oyama-Mahiro) in middle school. She befriends Mahiro, and the two become quite close to one another. Asahi talks with a pronounced Osaka accent. In the English…

mission-yozakura-family.desc: Affiliation: Yozakura Family Occupation: Student, Spy, Head of Yozakura Family Mutsumi is one of the main protagonists of the series. She is the wife of [Taiyo Asano](https://anilist.co/character/162723/Taiyou-Asano) and the current…

mission-yozakura-family.desc: Affiliation: Yozakura Family Occupation: Spy (Gold Rank) ~!Blooming: Destroy!~ The constantly jittery third child of the family, specialized in firearms. He often hides in a trash can. Shinzo is a scaredy-cat, and he also has a rather…

mission-yozakura-family.name: Kengo Yozakura
mission-yozakura-family.desc: Affiliation: Yozakura Family Occupation: Spy ~!Blooming: Assimilate!~ The cheerfully mischievous fifth child of the family, who can craft hyperrealistic disguises.

mission-yozakura-family.name: Shion Yozakura
mission-yozakura-family.desc: Afiliation: Yozakura Family Occupation: Spy, Hacker ~!Blooming: Analyzation!~ A fiercely competitive Gamer Girl and the fourth child of the family, she's a hypercompetent hacker.

mission-yozakura-family.name: Nanao Yozakura
mission-yozakura-family.desc: Affiliation: Yozakura Family Occupation: Student, Spy ~!Blooming: Adaptation!~ Nanao is one of the main supporting characters and younger son in the Yozakura Family. He is the sweet and gentle (but enormous) youngest brother, adept at…

mission-yozakura-family.name: Goliath
mission-yozakura-family.desc: The Yozakura family dog. He's a ferocious little thing.

mission-yozakura-family.name: Makoto Kawashita
mission-yozakura-family.desc: Age: Unknown Birthday: Unknown Affiliation: Kawashita Medical Office, TANPOPO Occupation: Doctor, Spy Makoto is a doctor and member of the organization TANPOPO.

mission-yozakura-family.name: Seiji  Hotokeyama
mission-yozakura-family.desc: A police detective associated with the Yozakura family. He helps cover up the family's actions in exchange for their cooperation in his investigations. He's a middle school classmate of Kyoichiro.

mission-yozakura-family.name: Kaoru Akikaze
mission-yozakura-family.desc: Kaoru Akikaze is a member of Hinagiku's Biology Unit who assisted Taiyo Asano in acquiring Dark Sweet tea leaves. He is also the Master of Cafe Hinagiku.

the-brilliant-healer-s-new-life-in-the-s.desc: Zenos is a young healer who's been kicked out of the party of adventurers for being deemed useless. He now runs a secret clinic in the slums as he doesn't have a healer's license. Having never received formal training, he is unaware of…

the-brilliant-healer-s-new-life-in-the-s.name: Lily
the-brilliant-healer-s-new-life-in-the-s.desc: Lilly is a young elf girl who was saved from the brink of death by [Zenos](https://anilist.co/character/349224/Zenos). She decides to help Zenos and moves in with him at the clinic.

the-brilliant-healer-s-new-life-in-the-s.name: Carmilla
the-brilliant-healer-s-new-life-in-the-s.desc: Carmilla is a wraith who reigns over the undead, yet her true nature remains a mystery. She lives on the second floor of the clinic and enjoys all the chaos that befalls [Zenos](https://anilist.co/character/349224/Zenos).

the-brilliant-healer-s-new-life-in-the-s.name: Aston
the-brilliant-healer-s-new-life-in-the-s.desc: Aston is the leader of the party of adventurers that Zenos belonged to. After recruiting Zenos from the slums, he used to make him work tirelessly.

the-brilliant-healer-s-new-life-in-the-s.name: Zophia
the-brilliant-healer-s-new-life-in-the-s.desc: Zophia is the leader of the lizardmen: one of three major demi-human factions that control the slums. (Source: Official Site)

the-brilliant-healer-s-new-life-in-the-s.name: Lynga
the-brilliant-healer-s-new-life-in-the-s.desc: Lynga is the leader of the werewolves: one of three major demi-human factions that control the slums. (Source: Official Site)

the-brilliant-healer-s-new-life-in-the-s.name: Umin
the-brilliant-healer-s-new-life-in-the-s.desc: She is a mid-level healer belonging to the Royal Healing Clinic.

the-brilliant-healer-s-new-life-in-the-s.name: Loewe
the-brilliant-healer-s-new-life-in-the-s.desc: Loewe is the leader of the ocs: one of three major demi-human factions that control the slums. (Source: Official Site)

tougen-anki.desc: Tsubakiri's partner. Her Momotarou ability allows her to create near-impenetrable walls with her bacteria.

hack-quantum.desc: Guildmaster of the adventurer's guild Yata Mirror. With her members she embarks on the legendary quest "The One Sin." (from dothackers.net)
